title: New local characterizations of the weighted energy class $\mathcal{E}_{χ,\mathrm{loc}}(Ω)$
summary: Let \(Ω\subset\mathbb{C}^n\) be a hyperconvex domain and let \(χ:\mathbb{R}^-\to\mathbb{R}^+\) be a decreasing function. This note studies the local weighted energy class \(\mathcal{E}_{χ,\mathrm{loc}}(Ω)\) introduced in \cite{HHQ13}. We establish two main results on local membership in this class.
